get.description: Photos captured on `date`'s month and day in earlier years, one group per year, most recent first, at most 20 groups, only years with a photo. The capture date is the EXIF `dateTaken` wall-clock date; photos without a valid one never appear. Counts stack RAW+JPEG pairs like `GET /photos?capturedDate=` and exclude rejected photos; the cover is the highest rating, then latest capture time, then highest id among them. On Feb 28 of a non-leap year, Feb 29 photos of earlier years join those years' groups; such a group's `capturedDate` is its Feb 28 when it has any Feb 28 photo (the count then includes both days), else its Feb 29. A Feb 29 request matches only Feb 29.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The client's local today, a real calendar date `YYYY-MM-DD`, year 1900 or later

get.description: Automatically detected events (a trip day, a party), newest first (`startAt` descending, then `id` descending). Events are recomputed in the background after scans and embedding runs: photos with a valid EXIF capture datetime (wall clock, no zone conversion), excluding rejects, with RAW+JPEG pairs counted once, are ordered by capture time and split where the gap is at least 6 hours, or at least 1 hour with a different city place or CLIP cosine similarity below 0.6; runs of at least 6 photos are events. Open one with the `event` filter of `GET /photos`.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Only events with at least one member anywhere below this folder; `photoCount` stays the whole event's count

patch.description: Sets the photo's star rating and/or pick/reject flag. `flag: null` clears the flag. Available regardless of the native scan mutation flag.

get.description: Photos nearest to the source photo by CLIP vector distance (L2), nearest first with ties ordered by ascending id. The source photo is excluded. Only completed vectors for the current model and committed thumbnail generation participate. Optional `minRating`, `flag`, and `collectionId` filters apply to candidates before ranking and the limit, never to the source. When the source photo has no usable vector, `indexed` is false and `photos` is empty.

Automatic CLIP zero-shot tags (at most three) for the photo, highest score first with ties by tag. Empty until the photo's vector has been tagged.

The photo's offline place: the nearest GeoNames city (population >= 5,000) within 100 km of its GPS location. `null` when the photo has no valid location, no city is that close, or the place backfill has not run since the location changed.

Junk-review candidates: photos that are not dismissed, not flagged, and unrated (rating 0) with at least one reason. Ordered by photo id descending and keyset-paginated with `cursor` (exclusive photo id). `counts` covers every candidate regardless of `reason` and `cursor`.

parameters.description: Only candidates with this reason

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page

200.description: One page of candidates with reasons and counts

post.description: Rejects (flag = reject) or keeps (dismissed from review permanently) the listed photos. Unknown photo IDs are ignored.

get.description: Near-duplicate (perceptual-hash) and burst groups among photos that have a perceptual hash and are not rejected, excluding dismissed groups. Ordered by group size descending, then newest (highest member id) first, and offset-paginated with an opaque `cursor`. `counts` covers every undismissed group regardless of `kind` and `cursor`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only groups of this kind

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page

200.description: One page of groups with counts

post.description: `keep` sets flag = reject on every member not listed in `keepIds` (1+ member IDs required); keeping 2+ members also dismisses the group they form. Files are never deleted or moved. `dismiss` hides the group until its membership changes. The group's current membership is recomputed and must still match `key`.

200.description: Rejected member IDs or the dismissed key
Active scans in deterministic recovery order
Durable scan status or null when the UUID is unknown

get.description: All collections sorted case-insensitively by name.

post.description: Creates a collection. The name is trimmed and must be unique case-insensitively. Optional `photoIds` are added immediately; unknown and duplicate IDs are ignored.

patch.description: Renames a collection. Changing only the letter case of its own name is allowed.

delete.description: Deletes the collection and its memberships. Photos are never deleted.

post.description: Adds photos to the collection. Existing members and unknown photo IDs are ignored; `added` counts new memberships.
Removes photos from the collection. Non-members are ignored; `removed` counts deleted memberships.

get.description: All smart albums sorted case-insensitively by name. Filter-only albums carry a live photo count and cover (highest matching photo ID); query albums report null for both.

post.description: Saves a named filter set plus an optional semantic search query. At least one filter or a non-empty query is required. The name is trimmed and must be unique case-insensitively among smart albums.

patch.description: Updates the name, replaces the filters, and/or sets (`null` clears) the query. The result must still have a filter or a query. Changing only the letter case of its own name is allowed.

delete.description: Deletes the smart album. Photos are never deleted.

tags.description: Tags with photo counts in scope, count descending then tag ascending

countries.description: Countries of current places with photo counts in scope, count descending then name ascending

places.description: Cities of current places with photo counts in scope, count descending then name ascending

pairedPhotoId.description: ID of this photo's RAW+JPEG pair partner (same folder and file stem), or null when unpaired. Lists show one row per pair; curation applies to both files.

pairedFormat.description: The pair partner's format: its rawFormat when the partner is RAW, otherwise its upper-cased file extension (e.g. JPG, HEIC); null when unpaired.

PhotoCurationPatch.description: At least one of `rating` or `flag` is required.

PhotoBounds.description: Location box in decimal degrees, edges inclusive. `south` must not exceed `north`; `west` greater than `east` crosses the antimeridian. Only photos with a valid location inside the box match.

folder.description: Restricts results to direct children of this folder

minRating.description: Only photos rated at least this many stars

flag.description: Only picks, only rejects, or only photos without a flag

cover.description: The most recently added member photo, or null when the collection is empty

capturedDate.description: The `capturedDate` filter value that opens this group in the grid

id.description: Smallest member photo id; stable while membership is unchanged. The `event` filter value.

startAt.description: First member's EXIF capture wall clock, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, no timezone

endAt.description: Last member's EXIF capture wall clock, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, no timezone

EventPlace.description: The most common city among located members when it covers at least half of them; otherwise the most common country when it does (`city` and `region` null).

SmartAlbumFilters.description: Canonical saved filters; absent keys apply no filter.

SmartAlbumFiltersInput.description: Photo filters saved with the album (the `GET /photos` filters minus `collectionId`). Empty strings and `filterRaw: "all"` mean no filter.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the photo's current place

place.description: GeoNames geonameid of the photo's current place

photoCount.description: Live count of matching photos; null when the album has a query

cover.description: Highest-ID matching photo; null for query albums or when nothing matches

name.description: Trimmed; unique case-insensitively among smart albums

UpdateSmartAlbumRequest.description: Omitted fields are unchanged; `filters` replaces the saved set; `query: null` clears the query.

name.description: Trimmed; unique case-insensitively among smart albums

score.description: Softmax probability over the vocabulary, 4 decimal places

JunkReason.description: Review reason. `screenshot`: tag screenshot; `document`: tag document, receipt, whiteboard, or text (tag score >= 0.5); `blurry`: thumbnail sharpness below the blur threshold; `dark`: thumbnail mean luma below the dark threshold.

junkReasons.description: Reasons in fixed order: screenshot, document, blurry, dark. Clients should ignore unknown values.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page

action.description: `reject` sets flag to reject; `keep` dismisses the photo from review permanently

updated.description: Existing photo IDs written, ascending; unknown IDs are ignored

DuplicateGroupKind.description: `duplicate`: connected perceptual-hash near-duplicates (2+ photos); `burst`: 3+ same-camera photos taken at most 2 seconds apart in sequence.

key.description: Opaque group identity; changes whenever membership changes. Pass back to resolve.

photos.description: Suggested keeper first, then ascending id

suggestedKeeperId.description: Highest rating, then pick flag, RAW, pixel count, sharpness, file size, lowest id

maxDistance.description: Largest pairwise perceptual-hash distance in bits; null for bursts

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page

keepIds.description: Required for `keep`: 1+ member IDs to keep; every other member is rejected
